title: Finite-temperature quantum Krylov method from real-time overlaps
summary: Accurately evaluating finite-temperature properties of quantum many-body systems remains a central challenge. Many existing quantum approaches require thermal-state preparation at each target temperature, making low-temperature calculations especially demanding in terms of circuit depth and accuracy. In this work, we present the finite-temperature quantum Krylov (FTQK) method, which combines stochastic trace estimation with a Hermitian generalized eigenvalue problem based on $\cos(\tilde H)$. The only quantum-side input required is the temperature-independent real-time overlap sequence…
